rows.quote: Frontmatter `name: spec-panel-stoprule`; `description` ends "(experimental variant: computed review-loop verdict)"
Under the title add the activation line `> Skill sc:spec-panel-stoprule-protocol`.
FR-10 stays (it feeds the table `sc:adversarial` consumes).
bullets 1 and 7 keep the 427 text (7 adds "and may not change the rubric or its hash"); bullets 2-6 are replaced; bullet 8 is new.
stop with `E-SKILL-MISSING`; never run the plain 427 loop under this name.

a failure table (grader reply invalid twice or Agent tool unavailable -> claims `unconfirmed`, verdict FAIL `incomplete`, no reviser edits; script exit codes and messages), and a "do not" list (no verdict line, no ledger edit after `seal`, no edit of `refs/rubric.md`).
`refs/rubric.md`: the literal text of section 2.3.
`refs/canaries.json`: 4 synthetic blocking and 4 synthetic minor claims (`{quote, span, outcome, evidence, answer}`), unrelated to any real spec; rotated by seed.
Takes `--rubric` and `--cap` so other loops can reuse it.
Known limit to put in a code comment: "markdown tables and wrapped cells are not normalised; upgrade if `quote-not-found` dominates the audit".
Frontmatter `name: finding-grader`, `tools: Read`, `model: sonnet`, `maxTurns: 10`, `permissionMode: plan` (same pattern as `confidence-calibrator`).

the variant equals `spec-panel.md` outside the replaced blocks (computed diff, so a later spec-panel change fails the test instead of drifting); `install_skills._has_corresponding_command("sc-spec-panel-stoprule-protocol")` is False.
a replay fixture built from control r1's spec v2/v3 and its 8 review-3 claims.

`begin` exit 4 on a prior review-3 FAIL; exit 5 on rubric drift, prior-verdict mismatch and baseline hash mismatch; ledger edited after `seal` -> `check` exit 6; `grade-raw` mismatch -> exit 6; `finalize` refuses a hand-typed `verdict:`
Run, do not edit: `tests/skills/test_review_severity_rule.py`, `tests/unit/test_cli_install.py`, `tests/recommend/test_routing_refresh.py`
New `docs/designs/spec-panel-stoprule.md` (this spec trimmed to the final decision); one sentence in `docs/designs/spec-panel-review-loop.md` section 11 pointing to it.
No routing-guide row, `/sc:help` entry or plugin mirror while the variant is experimental.
Then `make sync-dev`, `make verify-sync`; stage `src/`, `tests/`, `docs/`, `.dev/tasks`, never `.claude/`.
`src/superclaude/commands/spec-panel.md`, `~/.claude/commands/sc/spec-panel.md`, the rf-qa agents, `confidence-calibrator`, `evidence-validator`, `sc-implement-protocol`, `WORKER-CONTRACT.md`.
perl -pe 's#(/?sc:spec-panel)(?![-\w])#$1-stoprule#g' brief.md > brief.stoprule.md
Apply it to the **Arm B** briefs (review 2 and 3 pass `--re-review <prior> --baseline <saved copy>`)

The measurement copy of the command is built from the exact Arm B base file (472 lines, sha256[:12] `c8d80346a96c`) plus the section 3.1 edits, so the only difference from Arm B is the stoprule change.
**Rollback:** delete the three installed paths.
Never pass `--force` on the experiment machine: it overwrites every installed command, `spec-panel.md` included.
Writes a `begin` marker with a random 16-hex nonce, opens the ledger block in the stub report, prints the rubric and the list of changed hunks (difflib, whitespace-only changes ignored).
every changed hunk needs a claim or a `checked` line.

Every other form-valid claim, late-found ones included, goes into batches of at most 6 claims plus 2 canaries (one known-blocking, one known-minor, from `refs/canaries.json`), shuffled with seed `sha256(nonce, review, ledger)` and renamed `C1..Cn`.
A wrong canary answer rejects the batch (one rerun); a second failure leaves those claims `unconfirmed`.
Any `real:true` reinstates the claim (`confirmed-audit`) and the verdict becomes FAIL; the sentinel records `pre_audit=PASS`.
Refuses if the report already holds a line starting `verdict:`.
Re-extracts the ledger, verifies the seal and every `grade-raw` hash, recomputes every status and the verdict, compares sentinel, computed block and last line.
`stoprule.py check-disposition` lists any id the reviser applied outside D1..Dk (reported, never blocking).

`stoprule.py verify-transcript --report R --transcript <worker session .jsonl>` checks that each `grade-raw` text appears verbatim as an Agent tool result in the worker's transcript and prints `grader-integrity: verified|mismatch|unverified`.
The owner independently labels 5 sampled items (`stoprule.py audit-sample`, k = 5) and auditor-owner agreement is reported as its own number.
